player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo budafise agaciro; nimwandike ko ari [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ugukekeranya gukwiye kuba hagati y' {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Umukinyi 0 yaravye {guess0}; umukinyi 1 yabonye {guess1}. Ku bw'ivyo, ico barondera ni: {target} .

outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere yaratsinze izindi manza.
outcome.draw: Muri rusangi urukino ni ubusa ku bundi.
